Method of Attack: Exploiting CVE-2021-40444 Internet Explorer MSHTML remote code execution vulnerability via malicious ActiveX controls in Office documents to download and execute malware
Using malicious Word documents with embedded templates loaded via mhtml protocol to spawn IE and execute obfuscated JavaScript that downloads and runs malicious CAB and INF files as CPL files
Bypassing Office Protected View by tricking users to enable editing or using containers that strip Mark of the Web (MoTW) flag
Executing Cobalt Strike beacon payload for remote access and lateral movement
Attack Vector: Malicious Word document attachments exploiting Office template loading feature
ActiveX control exploitation via Internet Explorer triggered by mhtml URL
RTF files exploiting vulnerability without Protected View
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Word document named 'A Letter before court 4.docx'
side.html file loaded as Word template via mhtml protocol
ministry.cab file downloaded from remote site
championship.inf file executed as CPL file
URLs and files reported on VirusTotal
